system.description:
Arachni Traits

Characters with the arachni heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Age. Arachni age more rapidly than humans, reaching maturity around 10 years old and typically living 75-80 years.

Size. Arachni typically range between 4–5 feet tall and weigh no more than 150 lbs. Your size is Medium, though you may be Small with your Narrator’s permission.

Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, or 25 feet if you are Small.

Extra Limbs. You are in possession of four arms that terminate in claw-like hands. While your extra pair of hands are able to manipulate some items, they lack the fine manual dexterity of your primary arms. You may choose to gain an extra free object interaction or use the Use an Object action twice as a single action on your turn. These extra limbs may also be used to perform the seen components of a spell provided that they are not in use in some other fashion. Your secondary arms do not grant you additional attacks and cannot wield a shield.

Skitter. Your arachnid nature makes you an adept climber. You gain a climb speed equal to your Speed.

Web-Walker. Your movement is not impeded by spider webs or webs created via the web spell.

Arachni Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your arachni heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Agitating Hairs

As a bonus action you may use your secondary pair of arms to rapidly rub at any exposed area of your body, sending this hairs up into a cloud in a 5-foot radius centered on you. All creatures in the area of effect must succeed on a Constitution saving throw versus your maneuver DC or become blinded until the end of your next turn. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.

Threads of Fate

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.ljixftygfhi0sfsf]{Guidance} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.h4cib7rjhd5jqfff]{Guiding Bolt} once per long rest. At 5th level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.qsa7b22n3y1pbzf6]{Augury} once per long rest. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (whichever is highest).

Yarn Spinner

Whenever you take a short rest, you may begin telling a tale, fable, or legend to your allies. When an ally within 30 feet of you expends hit dice to heal themselves, they may reroll any results on the die of 1 or 2. They must use the new result of the roll.

Arachni Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better arachni and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Arbiter of Fate

You may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.3zt20n8mf29x3eju]{Death Ward} once per long rest without consuming a spell slot.

Good Vibrations

You gain tremorsense out to a range of 15 feet. If you spend your turn without moving, your tremorsense extends out to a range of 30 feet. If you use any movement or are forcibly moved (such as being shoved or by the thunderwave spell), your tremorsense reverts back to 15 feet until you spend another turn without moving.

Heightened Skitter

You are permanently under the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.kz3xe6ems34f2ubo]{Spider Climb} spell.

Additionally, when you would fall as a result of a spell effect or a failed ability check, you may use your reaction to produce a length of web that adheres to any flat surface within 30 feet of you, slowing your rate of descent. So long as you are able to attach a web in this fashion within range, you take no fall damage. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.
